Idle network runner

PROJECTGENESIS

Welcome. You are a runner on a broken network — you hold a node, mine it for data, and it keeps paying while you sleep. Come back to spend what it earned: better gear, a trade to learn, a region to cross.

See what you'll be doing ↓
NODE LINK-UP
Your progress lives on the server, so you can play from any device.
Pick your handle
This is your account name — one for all your characters. Friends will find you by it. Letters, numbers and _ , 3 to 16 characters. You can change it later, but only once a week.
Choose a character

The loop

Hold a node. Spend what it earned. Go further out.

Mine the node

Machines pull data around the clock. Upgrade them and the numbers keep climbing while you're away.

Learn two trades

Pick one gathering profession and one crafting profession. That pairing is yours — the rest you trade for.

Trade with players

The Auction House is a real market. List what you make, buy what you can't. Listing costs almost nothing; the tax is taken when it sells.

Kit yourself out

Fourteen slots, six rarities, affixes that actually change the run. Salvage what you outgrow.

Run expeditions

Send yourself out on timed jobs across sixteen regions. Fuel gets you there; loot comes back.

Raise a companion

Companions level with you and lend a bonus that shapes how you play — more loot, faster runs, richer sales.

The seven trades

⛏️Extractor 🧵Fabricator 🌿Bioharvester 🧥Outfitter ⚔️Weaponsmith 💍Jewelcrafter ⚗️Chemist

Two are yours to keep. Everything else comes from other runners.
